label: 3.03ct I VVS2 — attractive motion, dark centre
commentary: Karl_K considered this original 'Target in the centre' candidate close to promising but a little too dark centrally in the vendor spin; he wanted ASET to decide whether it mattered in real viewing (#9) and praised the crown height (#10). lovedogs preferred it among the first three while noting the static centre darkness (#11). The purchaser later inspected and filmed the stone (#57/#59), finding static face-up darkness less attractive but flashes on tilt appealing, then compared it in hand with a larger 3.19ct stone (#66). The later context is part of this same candidate, not a second stone; no certified report or locally playable 360 has been established for this learning reference.
